# Shane feature fitting targets

Original MakeHuman CC0 target files. Parent `../../LICENSE.md` and individual
headers identify the data license. `provenance.json` records each upstream URL,
Git blob ID, SHA-256 and the artist-selected blend weight used by the builder.

These controls were selected by comparing Shane's archived front/profile
character views with the anatomical base: fuller/softly squared lower face,
broader mouth, nose adjustment, narrower eye opening and subtle facial folds.
They are visual fitting parameters, not biometric measurements, age or ratings.
The original source files are unchanged. All fitting happens offline in Blender;
the runtime requires neither MakeHuman nor network access.
